proposition: Two works of this range have Majlis 10196 copy dates after Ibn Turka's death on 14 Dhū l-Ḥijja 835/12 August 1432: the Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (838/1435) and, partially and with a question mark, the Iṣbāḥ al-Anwār (841/1438); Melvin-Koushki says only that perhaps no more than two works in the second half were copied after his death and does not name them.
